summary: 45 features and 3 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • tokenmonitor: stream usage updates and extend frontend config (c1b4fc5)
  • proposal: add dedicated planning direction defaults API (83ab056)
  • hero-avatars: migrate bundled avatar assets from webp to avif (7323ae7)
  • application: add AVIF hero avatar format and legacy webp migration (610d578)
  • web: gate openspec and commit prompts on interactive control (6f2af4c)
  • httpapi: resolve non-interactive hint gating for all message types (cf5ce4f)
  • orleans: allow interactive questions via control setting and route answers to owning session (6db4055)
  • application: expose interactive-control enabled flag from resolver (b7d4729)
  • application: surface WaitingForReply in config and stop checks (b0f6a36)
  • signalr: expose batch question answer hub method (1ed7276)
  • orleans: pause session in WaitingForReply and answer in batch (4b7bc69)
  • contracts: add WaitingForReply status and batch answer contracts (928afe1)
  • httpapi: gate preset task non-interactive hints on interactive control (9231442)
  • application: forward interactive control and proposal planning direction in frontend config (47b24b3)
  • httpapi: add user question answer endpoint (0162203)
  • orleans: wire interactive user question flow through grains (5ba8375)
  • signalr: map and broadcast user questions to clients (21ab86f)
  • prompts: parse user questions and drop non-interactive hints (016c43d)
  • contracts: add user question DTOs and Orleans grain contracts (a526222)
  • application: add agent CLI interactive control frontend config (286c2fa)
  • orleans: add agent work snapshot tracking and replay (b174098)
  • application: add frontend config notifications reset endpoint (bacd972)
  • claudehelper: add tool_reference content type (24e0c8f)
  • web: add stage boundary constraints to OpenSpec prompts (d7e99f9)
  • claudehelper: improve DshCli streaming with tool calls and thinking deltas (cbbaead)
  • orleans: add system reset app service with grain state and database targets (28d2b8c)
  • orleans: add session cancel result and cancellation handling (2a2c3c3)

HagiCode-org/web

  • proposal: load planning direction defaults from the backend (7a09dbd)
  • status-bar: add scroll sources and shared chip styling (d7d8db8)
  • token-monitor: show live token usage in the status bar (64191e4)
  • hero: accept AVIF for custom avatar upload (e5490b5)
  • promote: support tiered promote image sources with fallback (08b2cae)
  • session: add stopped-session agent switch decision (95be4dc)
  • session: surface waiting-for-reply status across the app (40b53d7)
  • user-question: add combined question card with reject and batch answer (348c78d)
  • user-question: add step-by-step wizard flow to the question card (b8a40a9)
  • agent-cli-interactive-control: name HagiTask in prompt copy (891ca76)
  • agent-work: add running and history sections to agent work list (1f843b9)
  • tool-result-image: render image tool results and read previews (fc3da67)
  • agent-cli-interactive-control: add AgentCLI interactive control settings (3501359)
  • user-question: add session user-question answering (854ec0f)
  • notifications: add notification settings reset section (d1cc373)
  • agent-work: add agent work list with live SignalR updates (8968ac8)
  • settings: add danger zone tab with system reset (55ab247)
  • session: scope cancellation to a single run and tolerate retired-run late events (e10a151)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • monospecs: raise MonoSpecs YAML file size limit to 1MB (2931e9e)

HagiCode-org/web

  • remote-voice: keep the voice input page fit on small screens (7f8da22)
  • conversation: render unanswered question hint for screen readers only (657f312)
